purpose.en: Train controlled internal rotation of the top hip while keeping the knees together in side lying.

text.zh: 膝盖并拢，小腿慢慢向上抬
text.en: Knees together, lift the shin up slowly

text.zh: 左侧卧，用左前臂承托，右手轻放上侧髋部
text.en: Lie on the left side supported by the left forearm, with the right hand resting on the upper hip.

text.zh: 双膝保持并拢，只让上侧右脚和小腿抬起
text.en: Keep the knees together and lift only the upper right foot and shin.

text.zh: 骨盆上下叠放，缓慢下放，不向后翻身
text.en: Keep the pelvis stacked and lower slowly without rolling backwards.

commonErrors.zh: 膝盖分开，做成普通蚌式开膝
commonErrors.en: Separating the knees into a regular open-knee clamshell.

commonErrors.zh: 翻骨盆、耸肩或甩上侧脚来增加高度
commonErrors.en: Rolling the pelvis, shrugging or swinging the upper foot to gain height.

items.zh: 膝与髋：膝盖轻靠，不夹紧或强扭；小腿抬起的幅度保持舒适。
items.en: Knees and hips: keep the knees gently together without squeezing or forcing rotation, and lift through a comfortable range.

items.zh: 左肩肘与颈：前臂稳定承托，不把身体重量全部沉进肩颈。
items.en: Left shoulder, elbow and neck: support steadily through the forearm without collapsing the body into the shoulder and neck.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制侧卧前臂支撑、髋内旋或膝部活动时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if side-lying forearm support, hip internal rotation or knee movement has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: One upper-right-foot/shin lift and controlled lowering counts as one rep with knees together. The 8-second clip contains two right-hip reps while lying on the left side and no side change. Preserve default 12; proposed 12 per working side (six loops) remains editorial pending. Change externally only after the side dose; no mirrored media is produced.
definition.movementSides: Lie on left forearm/side; right upper foot lifts via hip internal rotation with knees together. Available loop boundary after the side dose, not an in-clip or every-loop forced switch.
editorialNotes: startingSide=right指上侧主动内旋髋，left是支撑侧；2个右侧rep/8秒，无片内换边。默认12保持数值，提出每侧12（6loops）但原记录无明确perSide字段，编辑待审。
h-9090-liftoff为其已有替代关系的反向同髋内旋目标候选，90/90坐姿更高活动范围要求可列进阶候选，不认定固定难度顺序；同模式独立降阶ID未核定。
左手原mode=floor且左前臂支撑保留；不因新掌厚度静默改free丢锁。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b003.json真实源时间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog。rhythm只描述动画，不使用旧reps或holdSeconds来覆盖处方。
具体双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均为待审草稿；协同包含稳定/次要拉伸角色，不是额外高亮或肌电激活结论。
关系均为本仓库真实ID候选，不等于已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系缺口见逐动作说明。
通用医学筛查证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md的AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌，编辑/医学审核均保持pending。

switchPoint.semantics: Lie on left forearm/side; right upper foot lifts via hip internal rotation with knees together. Available loop boundary after the side dose, not an in-clip or every-loop forced switch. One upper-right-foot/shin lift and controlled lowering counts as one rep with knees together. The 8-second clip contains two right-hip reps while lying on the left side and no side change. Preserve default 12; proposed 12 per working side (six loops) remains editorial pending. Change externally only after the side dose; no mirrored media is produced.
